auto1.name: auto1
auto1.description: Generic 4-cylinder car engine idle/drive. Used by police, pickup, sander, rust, pink, square cars, ghostbusters car. The workhorse engine.
auto1.usedBy: police, pickup, sander, rust, pink, square, ghostbusters

scheurkar.name: scheurkar
scheurkar.description: Aggressive racing/screeching car engine, revving hard. Used by boom-car, Spanish car, Batmobile. Louder, brighter, more buzz than auto1.

pruttelauto.name: pruttelauto
pruttelauto.description: Sputtering, putt-putt little old car engine (uneven firing). Orange wagon.

belmobiel.name: belmobiel
belmobiel.description: Small mobile/scooter-ish engine for the "phone car". Mid buzzy.

motorloop.name: motorloop
motorloop.description: Motorbike engine, low rumbling with closely-spaced firing partials around 97 Hz.

bootloop.name: bootloop
bootloop.description: Boat / outboard motor chugging on water, low and watery.

tjoekbel.name: tjoekbel
tjoekbel.description: Steam-train chug + bell ("tjoek-tjoek" + bell ding). Locomotive bed loop.

harmonie.name: harmonie
harmonie.description: Marching brass band / fanfare loop (oompah). Melodic, brassy. Used by the fanfare float. Compose an ORIGINAL short brassy oompah loop in a similar register; do NOT copy any tune.

ghosty.name: ghosty
ghosty.description: Ghost wail / spooky hollow moan loop, slow vibrato. Tonal ~140 Hz with vowel formants.

ufo2.name: ufo2
ufo2.description: UFO hum / sci-fi oscillating drone loop. Warbling.

shark.name: shark
shark.description: Menacing low approaching swell (Jaws-like) loop. Very low, ominous.

olistamp.name: olistamp
olistamp.description: Heavy elephant footstep stomps loop (also the warthog body). Low thuddy rhythmic.

driveback01.name: driveback01
driveback01.description: A driving-car engine bed for the "drive02" car. Mid car engine.

sirene.name: sirene
sirene.description: Police two-tone siren wail, ~2.4 kHz cluster. Classic up/down wail.

boemcar.name: boemcar
boemcar.description: Boom-car subwoofer bass thump loop (doof-doof). Very low, rhythmic bass.

quepasa.name: quepasa
quepasa.description: A shouted Spanish phrase loop ("que pasa") from the Spanish car. Make an abstract rhythmic vowel-formant vocal stand-in, NOT speech.

schetenloop.name: schetenloop
schetenloop.description: Long looping flatulence (warthog 999 / burp mode). Wet buzzy low splutter with random wobble.

toeter1.name: toeter1
toeter1.description: Short car horn honk, a two-note dyad (~328 + 447 Hz) with buzzy harmonics.

toeter2.name: toeter2
toeter2.description: Alternate car horn honk, slightly different pitch/timbre from toeter1.

treinhorn.name: treinhorn
treinhorn.description: Deep train air-horn blast, low and powerful, long sustain.

leader.name: leader
leader.description: UFO "take me to your leader" alien voice clip. Abstract robotic/ring-mod formant gesture, NOT speech.

phone.name: phone
phone.description: Mobile phone ringtone (the bel-car). A cheerful melodic ring — synthesize a short original ringtone arpeggio.

batmanclip.name: batmanclip
batmanclip.description: A Batman movie/voice clip. Abstract heroic brass-y sting stand-in, NOT the actual clip.

gbustclip2.name: gbustclip2
gbustclip2.description: A Ghostbusters movie/voice clip. Abstract spooky vocal sting stand-in, NOT the actual clip.

olifant.name: olifant
olifant.description: Elephant trumpet blast (rising brassy bray). One-shot.

driveleo1.name: driveleo1
driveleo1.description: A shouted catchphrase voice clip variant 1 (drive car). Abstract vowel-shout stand-in, NOT speech.

driveleo2.name: driveleo2
driveleo2.description: Shouted catchphrase voice clip variant 2. Abstract vowel-shout stand-in.

driveleo3.name: driveleo3
driveleo3.description: Shouted catchphrase voice clip variant 3. Abstract vowel-shout stand-in.

i1.name: i1
i1.description: Hedgehog footstep 1: short soft low thump/scuff (~0.25 s).

win.name: win
win.description: Happy success chime when you reach a curb (+100). A short rising 4-note arpeggio (~619->931->1244->1863 Hz), bright bell/marimba timbre.

lose.name: lose
lose.description: Death "splat"/squish when hit by a vehicle. Bright noisy burst with a quick downward pitch — comic squash.

burp1.name: burp1
burp1.description: Comic belch variant 1. Voiced low buzzy burst (~80-200 Hz fundamental) with throaty noise and a short wet wobble. Each variant differs slightly in pitch/length/roughness.

music.name: music
music.description: Upbeat, slightly goofy arcade title+gameplay music loop (plays under the round). Bouncy bass + simple lead, retro game feel. Compose an ORIGINAL ~2 s loop; do NOT reproduce the original melody.

theburbgamemix.name: theburbgamemix
theburbgamemix.description: Burp-mode music bed: a sillier/funkier variant of the main loop. Compose an ORIGINAL ~2 s loop.
